svg.title: RoPE rotation of a coordinate pair
svg.desc: A query or key coordinate pair (x1, x2) at position m is rotated by angle m·theta to (x1', x2').

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: RoPE: rotate each coordinate pair by mθ

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: R(m) = [cos mθ −sin mθ ; sin mθ cos mθ]

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: θᵢ = b^(−2i/d), one frequency per pair
